scope: Human gate review of zero-based rows 285 through 320 inclusive of the capped Erdős resolved-theorem candidate queue.

method.statement_review: Compared every pinned natural-language block and exact formal type for polarity, quantifiers, domain, constants, and scope.
method.status_review: Checked every pinned teorth status record and the numbered Erdős page during review.
method.resolution_review: Matched live bibliography/remarks to fixed MR, arXiv, PDF, or git-commit evidence and inspected material formal-proof boundaries.
method.importance_review: Required a nontrivial numbered-problem resolution or separately sourced research theorem; routine support and elementary cleanup rows were rejected.
method.dedupe_review: Denied double credit to direct corollaries, special cases, and same-solution restatements inside the cohort.
method.rights_review: Emitted metadata, hashes, locators, and original assessments only; no third-party paper text or source docstring is copied into the review.

scope_boundaries.row_287: Rejected because the selected formal threshold inequality reverses the pinned prose/citation.
scope_boundaries.row_291: Pending until O'Donnell's dissertation is pinned and its exact construction scope is checked.
scope_boundaries.row_300: Pending exact EHS82 scope; DOI/MR metadata alone is not treated as theorem-text evidence.
scope_boundaries.same_event_dedupe: Rows 292, 301, 303, 305, 307, and 319 are denied a second credit in favor of their explicit or stronger companion rows; row 319 points across queues to supplemental_index 57.

validation.authority_preimage_format: ASCII source_sha256, review_sha256, ordered_stage_claim_ids_sha256, and ordered_identity_payload_sha256_values_sha256 separated by one space and terminated by LF
